ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the inscribed angle $\angle ACB = 130^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of the central angle $\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, take point D on the major arc AB, and connect AD and BD,\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ACBD is a cyclic quadrilateral,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$D=180$^\circ$−$\angle$ACB=180$^\circ$−130$^\circ$=50$^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $ \overset{\frown}{AB}=\overset{\frown}{AB}$ , \\
$\therefore$ $\angle$AOB=2$\angle$D=2×50$^\circ$=\boxed{100^\circ}.
